issues: Multiple H1 elements are present on the page, which violates WCAG guidelines for page structure and confuses screen reader users about the main topic.
An empty H2 heading is present, providing no semantic value and creating a confusing navigation point.
The heading hierarchy is illogical, with H2 elements followed directly by H5 elements, skipping H3 and H4, which severely impairs structural understanding.
Headings are used for content that is not a section title (e.g., contact information), misrepresenting the page structure.
Headings at the same level (H2) do not have comparable importance or parallel structure, making it difficult to understand their relationship.
A subtitle for a section is incorrectly marked as a main H2 heading, breaking the logical flow and hierarchy.
missingSections: The text 'ЈАВЕН ПОРТАЛ Nexus GIS - Општина Штип' appears to introduce a section but is not marked as a heading.
suggestions: Ensure there is only one H1 element per page, clearly defining the main topic of the content.
Remove all empty heading elements, as they provide no semantic value and can be confusing.
Correct the heading hierarchy to be logical and sequential (e.g., H1 -> H2 -> H3, not H2 -> H5), ensuring no levels are skipped.
Use headings exclusively for section titles that introduce content, not for contact details or other non-structural information.
Combine subtitles with their main headings or assign them appropriate sub-heading levels (e.g., make `( ОТЧЕТ НА ОПШТИНА ШТИП )` an H3 under `⇓ 365 ДЕНА ПРОМЕНИ ШТО НОСАТ ИДНИНА`).
Evaluate 'ЈАВЕН ПОРТАЛ Nexus GIS - Општина Штип' and mark it as an appropriate heading (e.g., H2) if it introduces a content section.
items.summary: The page has critical heading semantic issues, including multiple H1s, an empty heading, and a severely broken hierarchy, making navigation and understanding of content structure extremely difficult for screen reader users.
